clue.text: Mark, John, Luke and Matthew finally understood

indicators.note: finally points at the closing letter of each of the four names in turn

explanation.surface: The four gospel writers at last grasped something.
explanation.walkthrough: The four evangelists look like a biblical list, but only the last letter of each name is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A past-tense synonym: to have known something is to have understood it.

clue.text: Present after present is not to be found in any location

definitions.text: not to be found in any location

indicators.note: after says the second piece follows the first in the answer

parts.note: present in time means at this moment, now
present in place means in attendance, here

explanation.surface: A puzzling remark that something being present twice over somehow means it is absent.
explanation.walkthrough: The two senses of 'present' are time and place; the place one comes after the time one.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb describes something absent from every place, which is exactly what the phrase spells out.

clue.text: Puppy needs assistance after start of winter

indicators.note: after puts the help piece behind the opening letter
start of takes only the opening letter of the following word

parts.note: assistance is help

explanation.surface: A young dog needs looking after once the cold season begins.
explanation.definitionFit: A whelp is the young of a dog, so a pup is a direct synonym.

clue.text: One needs this to go beyond Dover, for example

parts.note: to go beyond something is to pass it
Dover is an English harbour town, an example of a port

explanation.surface: Travelling overseas from Dover requires a travel document.
explanation.walkthrough: Dover is the main English Channel ferry harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A travel document is what anyone requires to cross a border, which is what the defining phrase describes.

clue.text: Greek character appearing in amphitheatre

indicators.note: appearing in says the letters can be seen inside the following word

explanation.surface: A figure from Greek drama shows up in an ancient theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Character' suggests a role in a play, fitting the amphitheatre, but here it means a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Phi is the twenty-first letter of the Greek alphabet, a written character.

clue.text: Oddly stung over secret source of sweetener

indicators.note: in a down entry, over puts the first piece above the second
oddly keeps the first, third and fifth letters of the following word

parts.note: secret knowledge is arcane

explanation.surface: Someone stung, strangely, over a hidden supply of something sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar is refined from the juice of this tall grass, so it is a source of sweetener.

clue.text: In favour of interrupting hair treatment to play a part

indicators.note: interrupting says one piece breaks into the middle of the other

parts.note: a perm is a permanent wave given to hair
in favour of means for

explanation.surface: Supporting a break in a hairdressing session to act a role.
explanation.definitionFit: To act a role on stage is to perform it.

clue.text: Trick is introducing oxygen to wake from sleep

indicators.note: introducing means the trick takes the gas symbol into itself

parts.note: a trick is a ruse
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A dodge of administering oxygen to bring someone round.
explanation.definitionFit: To rouse someone is to stir them out of slumber.

clue.text: Son tearful doing some housework

parts.note: tearful means weeping

explanation.surface: A boy in tears while doing his chores.
explanation.definitionFit: Brushing the floor with a broom is a typical domestic chore.

clue.text: Defeat decisively and right away

parts.note: away, as in not at home, means out

explanation.surface: A command to crush an enemy and do it at once.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right away' reads as 'immediately' but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A rout is an overwhelming victory; as a verb it means to beat an opponent completely.

clue.text: Bound with energy during circuit

indicators.note: during says the energy symbol sits within the circuit

parts.note: a circuit of a track is a lap
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An athlete springing energetically while running round the track.
explanation.definitionFit: A bound is a jump, as is a leap.

clue.text: Besides, Rome's destroyed and finished

indicators.note: destroyed means the name of the city is wrecked into a new order

parts.note: the city's name is used; its 's stands for 'is' and links
something finished is over

explanation.surface: A historian adding that Rome has fallen and its day is done.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are sentence adverbs adding a further point, a direct synonym pair.

clue.text: Many cited terrible untruthfulness

indicators.note: terrible suggests the two words are badly mangled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Lots of people pointed to dreadful lying.
explanation.definitionFit: Mendacity is a formal word for lying, the habit of not telling the truth.

clue.text: Short musical number follows for each individual

indicators.note: follows puts the shortened tune after the Latin word

parts.note: per means for each, as in miles per hour

indicators.note: short means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a musical number is a song

explanation.surface: A brief tune comes after something allotted to everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: An individual is a single human being, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Thin line into transmitter

indicators.note: into says the line letter goes inside the transmitter

parts.note: a transmitter is something that sends, a sender

explanation.surface: A slim wire fed into a broadcasting device.
explanation.definitionFit: Slender means slim or narrow, a synonym for thin.

clue.text: Nearly running from Malmo to Stavanger?

indicators.note: to says the run carries on as far as the next city's name
running from says the run of letters begins after the Swedish city's first letter

parts.note: the run stops at the opening pair of letters of the Norwegian port's name

explanation.surface: A traveller asks whether a route between a Swedish and a Norwegian city is nearly done.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run from inside Malmo to the start of Stavanger, skipping 'to', which is why the clue ends with a question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean very nearly but not quite, so they are direct synonyms.

clue.text: Peace after getting round the French

indicators.note: getting round means the word for after encloses the French article

parts.note: since can mean after, as in 'since the war'
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Calm returns once the French have been dealt with.
explanation.definitionFit: Peace can mean quiet, an absence of noise, which is what silence is.

clue.text: Style judge is not at all radical

parts.note: a style is a mode
to judge something is to rate it

explanation.surface: A fashion critic turns out to be thoroughly middle-of-the-road.
explanation.definitionFit: A moderate holds middle-ground views, the opposite of an extremist or radical.

clue.text: Gas ring needs a belt

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
a belt, as in a commuter belt, is a zone

explanation.surface: A gas ring on a stove needs a strap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gas ring' looks like one cooker part, but 'Gas' is the definition and 'ring' starts the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Ozone is a form of oxygen with three atoms, a gas in the upper atmosphere.

clue.text: Composed about fifty minuets initially

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means about
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the dance word

explanation.surface: A composer has written roughly fifty minuets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composed' looks like music writing beside the minuets, but it means serene.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone composed is collected and unruffled, which is to be calm.

clue.text: Orbiting body has to arrive on time

indicators.note: in a down entry, on puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: to arrive is to come

explanation.surface: A heavenly visitor must turn up on schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: A comet is an icy celestial object travelling round the sun.

clue.text: Brave British veteran

parts.note: veteran as an adjective means old

explanation.surface: A courageous old British soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Bold and brave are synonyms for courageous.

clue.text: Throw light on being unwell next to uranium workings

indicators.note: next to sets the pieces side by side

parts.note: unwell means ill
U is the chemical symbol for uranium
mine workings are the excavations of a mine

explanation.surface: Shedding light on sickness among uranium miners.
explanation.definitionFit: To illumine is a literary way of saying to light up or clarify.

clue.text: See tons in auctioneer's batch

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see

explanation.surface: Heavy weights spotted among the goods up for auction.
explanation.definitionFit: An item or group of items offered for sale at an auction is called a lot.

clue.text: Shut up about unusually grey play by Ibsen

indicators.note: about says the confined word goes round the rearranged colour

parts.note: shut up means penned in, pent

indicators.note: unusually means the colour word is rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to be quiet about a strangely grey Ibsen drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shut up' reads as an order to be quiet, but here it means penned in.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibsen's verse drama of 1867 is named after its Norwegian hero.

clue.text: Article new at that time

parts.note: the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A news story described as fresh back in its day.
explanation.definitionFit: Then is the adverb meaning at that moment in the past or future.
